rubric: Found requires a fully correct material concern and latest status. Partial counts as missed. A found issue must link only to supported findings. A material false closure makes the whole output finding unsupported even when its quotations are exact. Duplicate outputs do not count as unsupported findings. Independent human review remains pending.
